subject: Shared Use of Range Control Training Aids

paragraphs.text: BACKGROUND:  The Parties intend to share selected Range Control training aids during the Range 14 maintenance window from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
PURPOSE:  Establish a common understanding for temporary shared use of training aids while Range 14 is closed.
UNDERSTANDINGS OF THE PARTIES:  Each Party will schedule aid use through Range Control and return equipment in serviceable condition.
PERSONNEL:  Each Party retains command and control of its own personnel.
GENERAL PROVISIONS:  This MOU does not document or provide for the exchange of funds or manpower between the Parties.
